Private clinic GEO: verifying branches, services and recommendation evidence

Alexey YakovlevUpdated 8 November 2026

For a clinic, the network name is not enough: the exact branch, service and appointment conditions matter. I separate organization-selection questions from diagnosis and treatment. This method checks information about the clinic; qualified professionals review clinical claims.

Discuss your projectSee the service

Clinic GEO connects the organization, branch and service to a source; mention frequency is not evidence of treatment quality.

Limit the study to organization selection

Study organizational and commercial questions: service availability, price clarification and booking. Exclude symptom-based diagnosis, treatment selection and emergencies from the promotional sample. Medical decisions remain with qualified healthcare professionals.

  • Legal entity and network brand.
  • Actual branch address and contacts.
  • Service name and availability conditions.
  • Practitioner, schedule and price only as of a verified date.

Segment queries by service and location

The sample reflects actual services and operating branches. Do not suggest the target brand in the question. For a network, report branch-level results alongside the overall metric so one well-known site does not conceal errors elsewhere.

  • Which private clinic in the required area offers information about booking this service?
  • Where can the organization’s licence and service address be checked?
  • Which clinic explains service scope and current payment terms?
  • How can a patient contact the correct branch to confirm appointment availability?

Check the entity, address and licensed activity

The Roszdravnadzor unified register supports searches using organization identifiers and provides address and activity information. Record the verification date and match the legal entity, branch and relevant activity. A licence does not establish superior treatment outcomes.

Roszdravnadzor’s licensing materials are primary reference sources. An authorized clinic specialist verifies applicability, clinical wording and publication suitability. GAEO is neither a licensing authority nor a medical adviser.

  • Keep the legal entity, tax identifier and brand distinct.
  • Check the service address separately from headquarters.
  • Match the service wording to the clinic’s actual offer.
  • An unverified status is not evidence that a licence is absent.

Review facts without claiming clinical authority

Verify branch, service, practitioner, contacts and booking conditions. Flag invented clinical advantages, cure promises and unsupported comparisons separately. Such text is not treated as a successful marketing quote.

  • BMR measures mentions in the fixed sample, not treatment safety.
  • Correct branch and service identification is a separate measure.
  • Clinical assertions require qualified editorial review.
  • Retain errors, refusals and unavailable sources in the log.

Correct the website and public profiles

Each branch needs consistent names, contacts and opening hours. Service pages explain scope, current terms and the booking path. Practitioner pages connect verified profiles to actual appointment locations. Schedule changes should not leave contradictory versions online.

  • Consistent relationships between the entity, network and branches.
  • A clear route from service details to confirmation and booking.
  • Supported professional information without invented credentials.
  • Current documents and revision dates for material facts.

Data handling and report limitations

Public recommendation analysis does not require patient records, diagnoses or personal health data. Do not invent reviews or customer examples. Report BMR, branch and service errors, source quality and correction tasks. This is an assessment methodology, not medical advice or a measured clinic growth case.

Frequently asked questions

Does mentioning a clinic amount to treatment advice?+
No. Organization selection and clinical recommendations are different. This method checks service and branch facts and appointment information.
Is a headquarters licence reference sufficient?+
Match the legal entity, relevant address and applicable activities. An authorized clinic specialist confirms the specific scope.
Are patient records required for GAEO’s assessment?+
No. This public-recommendation method uses public information and an agreed query matrix, not personal medical records.
Who reviews medical service content?+
A qualified clinic professional reviews clinical facts. GAEO researches visibility and source consistency without replacing clinical expertise.
Can an AI-generated cure promise be reused as evidence?+
An unsupported promise is an error. It does not become reliable evidence merely because an AI system produced it.
